protocol.matched_data: Identical existing fit onset T+30 eligible rows,labels,feature columns and unit weights;complete-window query groups for LambdaRank. No future eligibility in prediction.
protocol.features: Same rich/plain feature schema as the frozen decision-selected existing tree;no additional features or labels
protocol.models: Both600maxTrees/63leaves/lr.035/min_child60/lambda8/feature_fraction.9/4threads. Classifier binary logloss;ranker lambdarank truncation20 normtrue label_gain0,1. Two-seed equal mean;ranking scores are not probabilities.
protocol.decision: Separate decision period chooses top-k for each method;max overall proxy among incumbent/classifier/ranker,prefer incumbent then classifier on exact tie
protocol.selection: Later15days:chosen challenger replaces incumbent only if origin-deduplicated macro gain>=.01 and paired7day-block95CI lower>0
protocol.ongoing: Every candidate exactly copies all existing ongoing decisions. Only onset final step can change.
protocol.timing: Fixed tree iteration cap,no weight checkpoint selection. Existing checkpoint interval unused buffer. Fit->model seal->decision->decision seal->selection->selection seal->assessment.
protocol.assessment: Previously inspected public TRAIN development dates and observation labels;not latent truth or final/private. Source reports include historical outcomes;no new choices use assessment arrays.
